correctness.rationale: For positive directed 3-cycle edges, each Osborne coordinate update exactly averages the corresponding two log weights while preserving their sum. On the zero-sum plane the three projection lines have absolute pairwise cosine one-half; switch indicators under iid uniform choices are independent Bernoulli(2/3). The exact binomial error, moments and negative-binomial log-tolerance waiting times follow. The nonlinear normalized ell-one residual divided by log norm is bounded above/below on all post-first rays, with ratio tending to sqrt(2/3). This couples its tolerance time within bounded L2 difference of renewal hitting times and yields the mean, variance and CLT. The generic no-one-step-balance hypothesis is necessary. A standalone exact-rational finite-word checker passed 10005 tests, not used as proof of the infinite claims.

value.rationale: The three-vertex directed triangle is the smallest strongly connected cycle whose balancing dynamics has nontrivial repeated averaging. An all-initial-data conditional exact law, negative-binomial stopping distribution and original ell-one residual confidence-calibration CLT create a motivated and reusable benchmark for numerical matrix balancing and identify a mean-square versus typical-rate distinction invisible in general rates. The phenomenon and precise error criterion arise directly from the standard algorithm, not an arbitrary slice. No downstream algorithmic improvement is claimed.
